name: Op-amps and comparators
summary: Op-amps and comparators: building blocks of sensors, alarms and audio circuits.
identify: 8 or 14-pin chips marked LM358, LM324, LM393, TL072 or NE5532 on chargers, power supplies, audio gear and sensor boards.
test: Test in a simple circuit, such as a comparator fed two different voltages. Otherwise only heat or burn marks show a dead one.
